violations.text: The hand-washing sinks in the bar and bathroom were lacking handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of gray/black biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took unit out of service to be washed/sanitized. PIC disposed of ice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/07/2021
The wall next to the bar area is in poor repair (previous water damage w/ peeling paint). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026
